status: Post-hoc extension; all cohorts have previously been examined. Settings frozen before these new comparisons, not a preregistered blind confirmation.

neural_controls.optimizer: Unchanged parent AdamW1e-4 wd0.01; final checkpoint only; same generic frozen backbone and decoder initialization
neural_controls.source_half: 600 updates, batch1 source:600 source draws, same source exposure and updates as adapted but different batch size
neural_controls.target_only: 600 updates, batch2 target:1200 target draws, same update and batch budget as source-only and adapted
neural_controls.adapted_double: 1200 updates, batch2 (1 source+1 target):1200 source and1200 target draws; matches original source exposure but doubles updates
neural_controls.sampling: Separate source and target RNGs seeded identically per seed; first600 source_half draws equal adapted_double source draws; original controls retain their original RNG. No exact historical sample-order match claimed.

calibration.sampling: Deterministic equal group then frame allocations; same pixel indices across both backbones; standardization on calibration pixels only. Equal domain weights, approximately equal object weights within domains.
calibration.neural_comparison: Same training images, not equal dense-label pixel budget, capacity or original pretraining compute.
calibration.pcc_test_exclusion: SCARED8/9 omitted because public PCC training list includes all nine SCARED objects.
calibration.primary: All valid native reference pixels; no per-test alignment, no clipping reference depths

controlled_factors.implementation: Resize RGB to224x280 using official processor with normalization/rescaling disabled; then gamma and Gaussian sigma1.5 INPUT pixels; then official normalization without resizing. Includes DRENDS. Same GT/mask across interventions. New pipeline identity is used for paired contrasts.

statistics: Average frames within group, then groups, then seeds. Seed SD not population CI. Equal-bin mean uses only bins supported in all cohorts for a fixed method/bound; report retained counts; exploratory diagnostic, not primary ranking.
limitations: No new physical donors/device serials or clinical sizing/ICC collected; no SOTA or physical causal claim.
